title: CVS Refill Copay Leaderboard
dataSources: GoodRx prices (`goodrx:price`), CVS refills (`cvs:refill`), pharmacy pickups (`pharmacy:pickup`), and prescription adherence logs (`prescription:adherence`).
app: GoodRx price lookups, CVS refill confirmations, pharmacy pickup logs, and prescription adherence trackers streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cvs:refill copay_usd=*
| stats sum(copay_usd) as total_value, avg(copay_usd) as avg_value by drug_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks drug values by total and average copay across CVS refill events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `copay_usd` values for each CVS refill event and review total and average copay by drug.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total copay.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which drug shows the biggest copay numbers in your CVS refill data.
